summary: The eleven-story tower at 1455 Third Street, part of the Uber headquarters campus designed by SHoP Architects (per ArchDaily) and developed by a joint venture of Alexandria Real Estate Equities (51 percent) and Uber (49 percent) formed in September 2014; the Department of Building Inspection shows its new-construction permit completed on 2021-04-01, and Uber confirmed in October 2023 that OpenAI is leasing 1455 and 1515 Third Street from it.

milestones.text: Alexandria Real Estate Equities and Uber form a joint venture and acquire the 1455/1515 Third Street land parcels for ground-up development of two Class A buildings (422,980 rentable sq ft together); 15-year lease to Uber for 100 percent of the project
Department of Building Inspection new-construction permit application 201508245071 filed to erect 12 stories for office and daycare at 1455 3rd St (estimated cost $66,591,018)
SocketSite reports pile drivers arriving and permit paperwork filed to start driving piles for the headquarters building
Permit 201606039050 for installation of foundation piles (114 piles) issued
Department of Building Inspection records new-construction permit 201508245071 as complete (completed date 2021-04-01); the Assessor roll lists 2021 as year built for the building
An Uber spokesperson confirms OpenAI is leasing two buildings from Uber's Mission Bay headquarters, 1455 and 1515 Third St

costs.what: Estimated cost stated on new-construction permit 201508245071 (self-reported for the permit fee)

facts.value: Joint venture of Alexandria Real Estate Equities (51%) and Uber Technologies (49%), formed September 2014, per Alexandria's 3Q14 report

$125.0 million purchase price for both parcels (1455/1515 Third Street) including 423 parking structure spaces, foundation piles, plans and permits, 49 percent funded by Uber (Alexandria, 2014); not split by building

open_questions: Parcel 8721035 first appears on the Assessor roll for 2023 with the same location as lot 8721033 (rolls to 2022) and a lot area of 38,459 sq ft; the permits are filed under lot 033. No source read explains the lot merger, so the permit and 2021 year-built evidence is attached to this record through the shared 1455 3rd St address.

The map note's 486,600 sq ft combined OpenAI sublease figure and 'largest SF office lease since 2018' (The Real Deal) could not be opened (HTTP 403); the San Francisco Standard says only 'nearly a half-million square feet' and 'largest office lease in San Francisco since 2018'.

No source read gives a groundbreaking date or an opening or move-in month; the Department of Building Inspection completed date is a permit closeout date. SocketSite (2016) expected occupancy by mid-2018; the permit shows 2021.
Sources disagree on stories (11 on the Assessor roll, 12 proposed on the permit, eleven in ArchDaily).
